name: ebay-lister
description: Build and publish eBay listings conversationally, and decide where each SKU should sell. Groups local product photos, stages them to Cloudflare R2, resolves the eBay category and required item aspects, drafts title/specifics in MTGI's HTML house template, then runs the Sell Inventory chain (inventory item -> offer -> publish; update for live edits). Channel check compares eBay vs BrokerBin vs combo net revenue at 3 and 6 months from exact-SKU eBay research plus live BrokerBin asks/RFQs and recommends a channel. Also inspects, creates, and edits business policies and inventory locations. OAuth once; refresh token good for 18 months.
